items.title: Infinity Lava Parkour
items.creator: Dodo Studios
items.description:
Parkour above the lava until infinity! The further you get in the level, the more points you get! In total there are 95.000+ unique parkour combinations, how far can you parkour without falling?

- Earn trophies 
- Checkpoint and lives system
- For beginners and advanced players
- Play with friends!

items.title: Hatching Mobs
items.creator: PixelOneUp
items.description:
Time for you to look HATCHED and interesting! Which hatching mob will you choose?
These skins are perfect for your mob adventures!

items.title: More Ores
items.creator: Volcano
items.description:
Deep down in the mines, a plethora of ores are waiting to be dug. Collect the required ores to fix the Mining Drill and make mining a breeze! With these special ores come unique powers; you will never have to eat again with Vectrite! Pobryx, with its' healing properties, will make you fight monsters with ease!
Get your friends in and have lots of fun with the Mining Drill!

items.title: Angel and Demon Fashion
items.creator: Duh
items.description:
Celestial fashion never goes out of trend!

- 16 cool skins

items.title: Angel and Demon Teens
items.creator: Duh
items.description:
Who knew that angelic and demonic powers can co-exist? Join the alliance today!

- 14 cool skins

items.title: Demons and Angels United
items.creator: Duh
items.description:
Can you imagine a world where demons and angels are united? 

- 13 epic skins

items.title: Furniture: Gaming House
items.creator: Cypress Games
items.description:
Hey gamer, we have prepared a huge fully furnished house for you! Do not forget to invite your gamer friends, because this house is really huge and there is a room for everyone! Come on, the top floor room is waiting for you!

+ 24 custom furniture!
+ 4 skins including 2 that are FREE!
+ Perfect for roleplay

items.title: Axolotl Suits
items.creator: Cypress Games
items.description:
Are you ready to be the cutest player of the game with these Axolotl skins? Pick your favorite skin now and show the players how cute you are!

+ Axolotl themed
+ 12 skins (1 FREE)
+ Perfect for roleplay

items.title: Pajama Party
items.creator: Rainbow Theory
items.description:
The fun's never over, even if the sun goes down! Dress up in cozy sweaters and onesies as the day winds, or get ready to stay up all night playing games and watching movies with this fun pack! 

- Includes 8 Cozy skins!
- By RainbowTheory Studios

items.title: Middle School
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description:
Middle School is about to begin! Choose any of these modern outfits so you are ready for Middle School!

+ Modern skins
+ Includes 10 outfits

items.title: High School Drip
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description:
High School Drip has the best modern outfits for the school year! Do you need new drip for High School?

+ Includes 14 modern skins
+ Great for roleplaying or survival

items.title: Skyblock Sakura
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Skyblock Sakura is a unique aesthetic skyblock experience that includes Nether and End islands! Play with friends, gather resources, and explore the beautiful scenery!

+ Unique sakura-themed islands
+ Resource islands
+ 2 skins
+ Nether and End islands
+ By ArgoStudios and 4KS Studios

items.title: Dinosaur Park
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Be ready to explore the breathtaking wilderness of Dinosaur's Island! Traverse over 5 different biomes and meet over 60 different dinosaur breeds! Uncover all of the secrets left behind from your ancestors with style in your brand new indestructible Meep! 

- Amazing Adventure map
- Over 60 different tamable dinosaurs
- Over 5 different custom biomes
- By RareLoot

items.title: Anime Villain Base
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Have you ever wanted to live the life of an anime super villain? Yes? Then you’re in luck! A huge Japanese inspired castle and its vast underground layer awaits you! Plot your world domination the anime way!

- Anime survival spawn
- Mansion with secret base
- By RareLoot

items.title: Medieval Life
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Welcome, traveler! Immerse yourself in a beautiful medieval world full of detail.

- Lovely village
- Perfect to start your survival adventure alone or with your friends
- By Team Etyhria

items.title: Anime High School
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Experience school life the anime way! Live out your student fantasy in the cool and cute world of anime! Explore the school: will you hang out in the cafeteria or run some laps around the track? Choose your very own academic adventure!

- School survival spawn
- Fully furnished classrooms + more
- By RareLoot

items.title: Beach Resort
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Summer, sun and lots of fun awaits you with this beachy adventure! Enjoy your vacation with ocean-views at this wonderful retreat!

- Holiday resort survival spawn
- Several fully furnished houses
- By RareLoot

items.title: Break Free
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Master tricky rooms, play with your friends, and break free! Do you think you will be able to beat your friends in this challenge?

- Tricky parkours
- Many riddles to solve
- Various challenges
- By RareLoot

items.title: Axolotl Teens HD Skin Pack
items.creator: CupcakeBrianna
items.description:
Ready to splash in the water with your favorite axolotl friends? Dress to fit for the occasion with this cute collection! Featuring HD axolotls skins in four different colors and ten trendy teens wearing themed outfits.

+ 14 HD skins
+ By CupcakeBrianna

items.title: Block Camo 2 HD Skin Pack
items.creator: CupcakeBrianna
items.description:
These little blocky imposters are back for another round! Put on one of your favorite blocks or textures and run around with high definition style. Perfect for surprising your friends and playing survival.

+ 15 HD skins
+ By CupcakeBrianna

items.title: Battle Of The Elements
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
A timid flame shall become a raging fire, a still stream shall become a roaring river! In a battle as old as time the elements will once clash again to determine who will be the strongest of all!

- 12 Elemental skins
- By RareLoot

items.title: Medical Heroes
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Our actual heroes all around the world are doctors and nurses. Now it is your turn to put your medical mask on and save lifes! 
Are you ready, doctor? 

- 12 skins
- By Geniely

items.title: Nether Exploration Team
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Put your helmet and headlight on, it is time to explore the Nether! You have been chosen to take part in an expedition to journey the underworld and explore its many mysteries!

- 12 skins
- By RareLoot

items.title: Anime Neko Teens
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
With these 12 epic skins you will be the cutest anime player on you entire server! Connect to your role, play with your friends and enjoy jealous glances of your minecraft friends! 

- 12 skins
- By Rareloot
